Ellen — thanks for sending this over. Quick update from our side and an ask for a short internal handoff:

1) UK Addendum (IDTA): Redwood has a standard UK Addendum we ship with enterprise DPAs; it aligns with the model IDTA language but we do have two narrow non-negotiable operational notes (listed below). I can share a redline by EOD.

2) TIA evidence pack: we can provide a controls mapping, data flow diagram, and current subprocessor schedule. I will need CS & Trust to confirm one last audit artifact (recent SOC excerpt) before we send the full bundle. We expect to deliver the bulk of the evidence within 3 business days.

3) Subprocessor objections: typical turnaround is 5–7 business days to evaluate and either remediate or propose mitigations; if a customer requires full removal we may need 30–45 days depending on contract termination windows and replacement sequencing.

Marissa — can you pick this up and own the evidence bundle? Vivek / Laura, flag any legal or commercial points I should surface to Medicorp (discounts / SLA asks).

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(t) +1 415-555-0148

Hi team — picking this up. Plan and immediate asks below.

Plan (deliverables):
- Controls mapping (DOCX) — will include tech/process owners and last-reviewed dates
- Subprocessor schedule (CSV) — includes region and processing types
- Data flow diagram (PNG + connect notes) — shows where egress occurs and customer config options
- UK Addendum redline (DOCX) — highlight two operational notes for Medicorp Legal

Timeline: controls mapping + subprocessor schedule by Mon 18 Jun (EOD PT). UK addendum redline by Mon 18 Jun. Full compressed evidence bundle (including SOC excerpt) by Tue 19 Jun.

Immediate asks for Medicorp Legal:
- If you have any mandatory language in the IDTA that must be present (beyond the model text), send to me by Mon 17 Jun so we can incorporate in the redline review.
- If there are subprocessor names you expect to object to, flag them now. That will shorten remediation time.

Note on scope: our subprocessor map includes cloud infra providers (GCP/US-EU), monitoring vendors, and a managed model telemetry partner. For UK-specific routing, we annotate which subprocessors may access data outside the UK/EU.

Attachments referenced: redwood_subprocessor_map_20280614.csv (csv), redwood-uk-addendum-diff-notes.docx (docx)

Thanks Marissa — approved. A couple of clarifying points from leadership:

- If Medicorp insists on removal of a third-party subprocessor that we currently rely on for inference telemetry, we will offer either a migration plan + temporary exceptions or (if required) a contractual mitigation (SLA credit + limited access scope) until a replacement is validated. Removal is possible but non-trivial — we should set expectations at procurement.
- For the UK Addendum redline, do not accept broad audit request language that would require on-prem reviews; offer secure artifact sharing via the evidence drive and SOC excerpts instead.

Laura — please prepare a short commercial escalation path in case Medicorp requests an SLA variation tied to the Addendum. Aisha/Marissa please keep me looped.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
